opportunities.title: Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to researchers worldwide; projects must have a clear ecological science focus; does not cover salary of principal researcher, bench fees, or vehicle costs; living costs may be covered if essential.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 to support new and innovative ecological research projects, covering essential costs such as living expenses and specific project needs.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

amount.raw: £250 for virtual conferences/courses – £500 for in‑person events

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members who are PhD students or postgraduate researchers; must be based at a university or research institution; must present at the event and provide supporting documentation.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and postgraduate researchers to attend specialist field‑training courses or conferences, covering registration fees, travel and subsistence (up to £500 for in‑person events).

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members involved in teaching ecology at any level; projects up to 12 months; individuals only; no salary support; must not form part of a degree thesis.
opportunities.summary: Funds research that improves teaching and learning practices in ecology, supporting evidence‑based or systematic reviews, innovative educational methods, and dissemination of best practices.

opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members; groups of 8–15 individuals from diverse institutions and career stages; must include international participation; lead applicant must have BES membership.
opportunities.summary: Supports interdisciplinary groups to conduct data synthesis projects, covering travel, venue hire, computing costs, and related expenses to produce synthesis datasets and publications.

opportunities.title: Long‑term Research Grants

amount.raw: £3,500 (first five years) with further £3,500 available in year 6

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members; individuals (not organisations); open to ecologists, conservation practitioners, reserve managers, consultants, and academics; must obtain necessary permits.
opportunities.summary: Provides a modest annual contribution (≈£500 per year) to support long‑term data collection over ten years, with an initial £3,500 payment covering the first five years.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members (individuals, teams or organisations); projects up to 12 months; must target non‑academic public audiences; no restriction on applicant location.
opportunities.summary: Funds public outreach and science communication activities that raise awareness of ecological science, careers, and actions for environmental benefit.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members who are citizens and based in a Global South country; must have an accepted abstract for the BES Annual Meeting; must not have received a BES Training and Travel Grant in the previous three years.
opportunities.summary: Provides travel grants (up to £1,000) for Global South researchers to attend the BES Annual Meeting 2026, covering travel, registration, and related costs.
